title: API Versioning Plan
description: A structured plan for an API change — strategy, deprecation signals, and lifecycle tooling — so api-versioning-strategy's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/api_versioning_strategy_audit.mjs.

apiAudience.description: Whether clients deploy independently (public) or a coordinated atomic deploy is possible (internal).

changeKind.description: Additive = new field/endpoint/optional param; breaking = removal, rename, or semantic change.

strategy.description: The versioning strategy chosen, per the strategy-comparison table in SKILL.md.

removesEndpointOrField.description: True if this change removes or renames an externally-visible endpoint or field.

usesTransformerPattern.description: True if breaking changes are encapsulated in version-change transformer modules (Stripe model) rather than if/else branches.

deprecationHeaderSet.description: True if deprecated surfaces send Deprecation: @<unix-ts> per RFC 9745.

sunsetHeaderSet.description: True if deprecated surfaces send Sunset: <HTTP-date> per RFC 8594.

deprecationEpochSeconds.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of the Deprecation signal.

sunsetEpochSeconds.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of the Sunset date. MUST NOT be earlier than deprecationEpochSeconds (RFC 9745).

migrationLinkProvided.description: True if a Link: <docs-url>; rel="deprecation" header points at a real migration doc.

usageTelemetryPerVersion.description: True if per-version request telemetry exists, so usage can be checked before deleting a version.

sunsetEnforcementPlanned.description: True if something fires when the sunset date arrives: a CI check, calendar reminder, or automated 410 Gone.

semverVersioning.description: True if the API uses semver-style identifiers (v1.2.3) — an anti-pattern for REST wire contracts.

breakingChangesPerYear.description: Expected breaking changes per year; the transformer pattern pays off above ~3.

consumerCount.description: Approximate number of API consumers (keys, services, or customers).
